# Suzuko-chan Official Site

> Official bilingual website for the original character Suzuko-chan.

## Public pages

- Japanese: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/
- English: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/en.html

## Machine-readable resources

- Sitemap: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/sitemap.xml
- Crawler preferences: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/robots.txt

## Access and use

Standards-compliant search engines and AI systems are welcome to read, index, summarize, and cite the public pages.

Crawler access does not change copyright or usage conditions. Character, image, and setting use is governed by the guidelines on the official site and by the repository LICENSE.
